<response>The AI does not possess consciousness, spirituality, or the ability to perceive or reflect "soul" or "spiritual energy." If you're curious about how systems (like hydraulic ones) interact with inputs, we can explore that scientifically—though spiritual exploration would require other frameworks.</response>
